# Game containment

Game, inning, half inning, and plate appearance form an explicit occurrent-part hierarchy.

This view shows the ontology pattern without MLB JSON paths or RML machinery.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    N01["Baseball Game"]
    N02["Inning"]
    N03["Half Inning"]
    N04["Plate Appearance"]
    N05["Baseball Field"]
    N01 -->|has occurrent part| N02
    N02 -->|has occurrent part| N03
    N02 -->|occurrent part of| N01
    N02 -->|occurs at| N05
    N03 -->|has occurrent part| N04
    N03 -->|occurrent part of| N02
    N03 -->|occurs at| N05
```
